say:0:1621201001:0.text: That's Cassadee... out for a stroll?
say:0:1621201001:0.male: That's Cassadee... out for a stroll?
say:0:1621201001:0.female: That's Cassadee... out for a stroll?

say:1:1621202001:0.text: You felt it too, didn't you? Something's wrong with the forest. That's why you're here, right?
say:1:1621202001:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，你一定是也察觉到了森林中有什么不对的地方，来...
say:1:1621202001:0.male: You felt it too, didn't you? Something's wrong with the forest. That's why you're here, right?
say:1:1621202001:0.female: You felt it too, didn't you? Something's wrong with the forest. That's why you're here, right?

choice_prompt:2:1621202001.text: You felt it too, didn't you? Something's wrong with the forest. That's why you're here, right?
choice_prompt:2:1621202001.source_cn: 梅林大人，你一定是也察觉到了森林中有什么不对的地方，来调查的吧？
choice_prompt:2:1621202001.male: You felt it too, didn't you? Something's wrong with the forest. That's why you're here, right?
choice_prompt:2:1621202001.female: You felt it too, didn't you? Something's wrong with the forest. That's why you're here, right?

say:3:1621202002:0.text: I picked up on a few odd signs myself. Seems we were both drawn here for the same reason.
say:3:1621202002:0.source_cn: 我也察觉到一些异常才过来的，看来也并非是巧合。
say:3:1621202002:0.male: I picked up on a few odd signs myself. Seems we were both drawn here for the same reason.
say:3:1621202002:0.female: I picked up on a few odd signs myself. Seems we were both drawn here for the same reason.

say:4:1621202005:0.text: Lately I haven't seen any of the usual critters. It's been awfully quiet.
say:4:1621202005:0.source_cn: 这几天我注意到，森林里的小动物似乎少了很多，安静得有些反常。
say:4:1621202005:0.male: Lately I haven't seen any of the usual critters. It's been awfully quiet.
say:4:1621202005:0.female: Lately I haven't seen any of the usual critters. It's been awfully quiet.

say:5:1621202006:0.text: No predators either... no claw marks, no broken branches. Could be something new moved in, but that's just a guess.
say:5:1621202006:0.source_cn: 同时也没发现大型猛兽或掠食性魔物的踪迹……虽然不能排除...
say:5:1621202006:0.male: No predators either... no claw marks, no broken branches. Could be something new moved in, but that's just a guess.
say:5:1621202006:0.female: No predators either... no claw marks, no broken branches. Could be something new moved in, but that's just a guess.

say:6:1621202007:0.text: I just walked a full loop. Didn't even spot a single squirrel. The silence is unsettling.
say:6:1621202007:0.source_cn: 我刚刚沿着这片林子走了一圈，一只松鼠都没遇见，静得让人不安。
say:6:1621202007:0.male: I just walked a full loop. Didn't even spot a single squirrel. The silence is unsettling.
say:6:1621202007:0.female: I just walked a full loop. Didn't even spot a single squirrel. The silence is unsettling.

say:8:1621202003:0.text: Oh, I see... Still, there's something wrong with this part of the forest. Best to keep an eye out.
say:8:1621202003:0.source_cn: 这样啊……不过，就算是偶遇，这片区域的状态也确实值得留意。
say:8:1621202003:0.male: Oh, I see... Still, there's something wrong with this part of the forest. Best to keep an eye out.
say:8:1621202003:0.female: Oh, I see... Still, there's something wrong with this part of the forest. Best to keep an eye out.

say:9:1621202004:0.source_cn: 连梅林大人也察觉到了，看来不是我的多疑。

say:1:1621202101:0.text: Just then, a faint, brittle cry drifts out from the depths of the forest, carried on the wind.
say:1:1621202101:0.source_cn: 此时，一道细碎、几乎要被风吹散的叫声从林子深处传来。

say:2:1621202102:1.text: It sounds like a small creature, weak and struggling.
say:2:1621202102:1.source_cn: 那是小动物的声音，虚弱、短促，如同某种挣扎。

say:5:1621202103:0.text: Wait, did you hear that? Was that a squirrel? Or is my mind playing tricks on me?
say:5:1621202103:0.source_cn: 等等，您听到了吗？那是——幻想松鼠的叫声？
say:5:1621202103:0.male: Wait, did you hear that? Was that a squirrel? Or is my mind playing tricks on me?
say:5:1621202103:0.female: Wait, did you hear that? Was that a squirrel? Or is my mind playing tricks on me?

say:6:1621202104:1.text: It's not a warning cry, or a mating call. It sounds tired... like it's barely hanging on.
say:6:1621202104:1.source_cn: 声音很微弱，听上去不像是在求偶或警戒……更像是，虚弱？
say:6:1621202104:1.male: It's not a warning cry, or a mating call. It sounds tired... like it's barely hanging on.
say:6:1621202104:1.female: It's not a warning cry, or a mating call. It sounds tired... like it's barely hanging on.

say:7:1621202105:1.text: Magister, we should check it out!
say:7:1621202105:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我们过去看看吧！
say:7:1621202105:1.male: Magister, we should check it out!
say:7:1621202105:1.female: Magister, we should check it out!

say:0:1621203001:0.text: It came from deeper inside the forest.
say:0:1621203001:0.source_cn: 松鼠的叫声像是从森林深处传来的。
say:0:1621203001:0.male: It came from deeper inside the forest.
say:0:1621203001:0.female: It came from deeper inside the forest.

say:1:1621204001:1.text: It's getting clearer. We're close. But...
say:1:1621204001:1.source_cn: 声音越来越近了，应该就在这里，可是……
say:1:1621204001:1.male: It's getting clearer. We're close. But...
say:1:1621204001:1.female: It's getting clearer. We're close. But...

say:2:1621204002:0.text: Wow, this tree's crawling with squirrels! There's no way to tell which one cried out.
say:2:1621204002:0.source_cn: 这棵树上的松鼠也太多了！根本分不清是哪只松鼠发出的叫声。
say:2:1621204002:0.male: Wow, this tree's crawling with squirrels! There's no way to tell which one cried out.
say:2:1621204002:0.female: Wow, this tree's crawling with squirrels! There's no way to tell which one cried out.

choice_prompt:3:1621204002.text: Wow, this tree's crawling with squirrels! There's no way to tell which one cried out.
choice_prompt:3:1621204002.source_cn: 这棵树上的松鼠也太多了！根本分不清是哪只松鼠发出的叫声。
choice_prompt:3:1621204002.male: Wow, this tree's crawling with squirrels! There's no way to tell which one cried out.
choice_prompt:3:1621204002.female: Wow, this tree's crawling with squirrels! There's no way to tell which one cried out.

say:4:1621204003:0.text: I thought about that too, but they're on edge... I don't want to spook them.
say:4:1621204003:0.source_cn: 我也在考虑用变形术……但它们看起来神色慌张。
say:4:1621204003:0.male: I thought about that too, but they're on edge... I don't want to spook them.
say:4:1621204003:0.female: I thought about that too, but they're on edge... I don't want to spook them.

say:5:1621204004:0.text: Yeah, no chance they'll listen now.
say:5:1621204004:0.male: Yeah, no chance they'll listen now.
say:5:1621204004:0.female: Yeah, no chance they'll listen now.

say:6:1621204008:0.text: Whatever we do, let's not <u><link=Case><style=highlight>spook</style></link></u> it again, or we'll lose our only lead.
say:6:1621204008:0.source_cn: 无论如何，我们不能再让它<u><link=Case><...
say:6:1621204008:0.male: Whatever we do, let's not <u><link=Case><style=highlight>spook</style></link></u> it again, or we'll lose our only lead.
say:6:1621204008:0.female: Whatever we do, let's not <u><link=Case><style=highlight>spook</style></link></u> it again, or we'll lose our only lead.

say:8:1621204009:0.text: Sounds like you're in a bit of a bind.
say:8:1621204009:0.source_cn: 看来两位朋友遇到了点麻烦。

choice:3:0:1.text: Use transfiguration to talk to them.
choice:3:0:1.male: Use transfiguration to talk to them.
choice:3:0:1.female: Use transfiguration to talk to them.

say:12:1621204006:0.text: Still nothing. They all look the same!
say:12:1621204006:0.source_cn: 嗯……还是不行，它们长得实在太像了！
say:12:1621204006:0.male: Still nothing. They all look the same!
say:12:1621204006:0.female: Still nothing. They all look the same!

say:13:1621204007:1.text: Doesn't seem like we've got a better plan...
say:13:1621204007:1.male: Doesn't seem like we've got a better plan...
say:13:1621204007:1.female: Doesn't seem like we've got a better plan...

choice:3:2:3.text: Let's catch one and take a closer look.
choice:3:2:3.male: Let's catch one and take a closer look.
choice:3:2:3.female: Let's catch one and take a closer look.

say:1:1621206001:0.text: There's always some little creature out here that needs looking after, wouldn't you say?
say:1:1621206001:0.source_cn: 总有些小生命需要我们的守望，对吗？

say:2:1621206002:0.text: Name's Hamell. Pleasure to meet you...
say:2:1621206002:0.source_cn: 我叫哈梅尔，很荣幸能结识两位魔法师朋友……

choice_prompt:3:1621206002.text: Name's Hamell. Pleasure to meet you...
choice_prompt:3:1621206002.source_cn: 我叫哈梅尔，很荣幸能结识两位魔法师朋友……

say:4:1621206003:1.text: Following? Oh no, I prefer to think of it as... drifting with the wind.
say:4:1621206003:1.source_cn: 跟踪？不不，我更愿意称之为——随风而行。

say:5:1621206004:1.text: I simply go where I'm guided. The path led me here.
say:5:1621206004:1.source_cn: 我只是一个遵从指引的人，来到此地。

say:6:1621206005:1.text: And if there's one thing I've learned, it's that when the wind spins a tale, a good ending always awaits. We're all just characters in that tale.
say:6:1621206005:1.source_cn: 不过，就我过往的经验来看，风编织的故事，总会有一个好结...

say:7:1621206006:0.text: Names are just a worldly formality, but since you asked, I won't be coy.
say:7:1621206006:0.source_cn: 名字只是尘世的标签，不过既然你问了，我也不打算卖关子。

say:8:1621206007:0.text: Hamell Sylven. A slow-footed traveler, a tone-deaf flutist, and perhaps most importantly, a member of the Animal Protection Association.
say:8:1621206007:0.source_cn: 我的全名为哈梅尔·西尔文，一个走路太慢的旅人，一个五音...

say:9:1621206008:0.text: Those first two things I might struggle with, but when it comes to protecting animals, I never slack.
say:9:1621206008:0.source_cn: 不过与前两个身份不同，保护动物这件事，我从未懈怠。

say:10:1621206009:1.text: Maybe that's because I spend more time watching the stars than watching my step.
say:10:1621206009:1.source_cn: 也许是因为我习惯仰望星辰，而不是脚下的路。

say:11:1621206010:1.text: You're right though. This forest has heard my music, but it isn't where I'm rooted.
say:11:1621206010:1.source_cn: 你说得对，这片土地容纳了我的笛声，却不是我的根。

choice:3:2:3.text: You don't look like a local.
choice:3:2:3.male: You don't look like a local.
choice:3:2:3.female: You don't look like a local.

say:12:1621206011:1.text: First, we find out what's wrong with these little guys. Then, we help them heal. But I should warn you—whatever is going on, it's serious. If we delay much longer, they might not make it...
say:12:1621206011:1.source_cn: 当然是为这些小家伙们排查病情和治疗。不过我不得不提醒两...

say:15:1621206013:0.text: I get it. You don't know me. And this all came out of nowhere. Fortunately, I've picked up a certain... technique. Let's call it a gentle way of asking the forest for answers.
say:15:1621206013:0.source_cn: 两位的犹豫我能理解。不过恰巧，我掌握一项小小的技艺，能...

say:16:1621206014:0.text: Hamell slowly pulls out an old flute. Its faded surface catches the sunlight, shimmering faintly.
say:16:1621206014:0.source_cn: 哈梅尔从怀中缓缓取出一支古旧的笛子，褪色的笛身在太阳下...

say:18:1621206015:1.text: You instinctively frown. Is this some beast-tamer's trick? Or sound-based magic?
say:18:1621206015:1.source_cn: 你下意识皱了皱眉——驯兽人的把戏？还是那种音律魔法？
say:18:1621206015:1.male: You instinctively frown. Is this some beast-tamer's trick? Or sound-based magic?
say:18:1621206015:1.female: You instinctively frown. Is this some beast-tamer's trick? Or sound-based magic?

say:19:1621206016:0.text: You've read about spells like this—songs that bend the will of beasts.
say:19:1621206016:0.source_cn: 你曾在古籍中读到过类似的法术，只需一段旋律，就能操控生灵。
say:19:1621206016:0.male: You've read about spells like this—songs that bend the will of beasts.
say:19:1621206016:0.female: You've read about spells like this—songs that bend the will of beasts.

say:22:1621206018:1.text: Easy now. I promise, the squirrels won't be frightened anymore.
say:22:1621206018:1.source_cn: 请稍安勿躁，我保证，松鼠们不会再受惊了。

choice:3:3:4.text: How exactly are you planning to help?
choice:3:3:4.male: How exactly are you planning to help?
choice:3:3:4.female: How exactly are you planning to help?

say:1:1621208001:1.text: Remarkable... the squirrels are lining up and coming over on their own.
say:1:1621208001:1.source_cn: 神奇……松鼠们竟然排着长队自己走出来。

say:2:1621208002:1.text: See? No distress. They're coming to us on their own. Now then... let's find the one who cried out.
say:2:1621208002:1.source_cn: 没有惊扰到它们，对吗？现在，让我来看看是哪只小家伙出了问题。

say:3:1621208003:1.text: This one here... its breathing is erratic, its limbs are twitching... and its energy is scattered.
say:3:1621208003:1.source_cn: 看这只的气息……紊乱、虚浮，爪尖还有微微的颤抖。

say:4:1621208004:1.text: So that's it. This one's been <style="highlight">poisoned</style>. It must've eaten something that doesn't grow around here... a foreign fruit. If the toxin spreads further, it won't survive.

say:5:1621208005:1.text: We need to flush that toxin out of its system.
say:5:1621208005:1.source_cn: 我们得想办法给这个小家伙解毒。

say:6:1621208006:1.text: Hamell pulls out a booklet and flips through it with practiced ease, stopping at a page filled with symbols and sketches.
say:6:1621208006:1.source_cn: 哈梅尔熟练地抽出一本随身小册子，快速翻阅后，抽出一页写...

say:7:1621208007:1.text: This is a <style="highlight">soothing remedy</style>. Simple ingredients, but I'll need your help gathering them.

say:8:1621208008:1.text: I'll keep its breathing steady in the meantime, and make sure that little heart doesn't give out.
say:8:1621208008:1.source_cn: 我暂时要替它理一理呼吸的节奏，稳住这颗小心脏。

choice_prompt:9:1621208008.text: I'll keep its breathing steady in the meantime, and make sure that little heart doesn't give out.
choice_prompt:9:1621208008.source_cn: 我暂时要替它理一理呼吸的节奏，稳住这颗小心脏。

say:10:1621208009:0.text: A nod from you, and I'll begin. With any luck, the tune won't have to go on for long—our little audience is running out of time.
say:10:1621208009:0.source_cn: 点头即允诺。希望这首曲子不必演奏太久，我们的小听众可等...

say:11:1621208014:1.text: Now go, bring me what I need.

say:12:1621208015:0.text: Don't worry, Mr. Hamell, we'll have that remedy ready in no time.
say:12:1621208015:0.source_cn: 你放心吧，哈梅尔先生，我们会尽快制作舒缓药。

say:14:1621208010:0.text: I've charmed more than my share of ears. I know how easy it is to win trust with magic...
say:14:1621208010:0.source_cn: 我与太多耳朵打过交道，深知利用魔法取信很容易……

say:15:1621208011:0.text: Rest assured, this flute's never caused harm. Not to beast nor human.
say:15:1621208011:0.source_cn: 但我这支笛子，从没用来伤害——对动物是如此，对人亦如此。

choice:9:1:2.text: Alright. We'll trust you, for now.
choice:9:1:2.male: Alright. We'll trust you, for now.
choice:9:1:2.female: Alright. We'll trust you, for now.

say:17:1621208013:0.text: Your rescuers are on the move.
say:17:1621208013:0.source_cn: 你的英雄大人们已经准备出发了。

say:0:1621209001:0.text: We'll gather the herbs first. Might need you to confirm the recipe later.
say:0:1621209001:0.source_cn: 我们先去采集，待会儿可能要你确认药方。
say:0:1621209001:0.male: We'll gather the herbs first. Might need you to confirm the recipe later.
say:0:1621209001:0.female: We'll gather the herbs first. Might need you to confirm the recipe later.

say:0:1621210001:0.text: You've got it. That's the one.
say:0:1621210001:0.source_cn: 确认药方没错，就是这种草药。

say:0:1621210101:0.text: No doubt about it, that's the right herb.

say:0:1621211001:0.text: We're good. This is what the recipe calls for.
say:0:1621211001:0.source_cn: 没有问题，药方上写的药草就是这种。

say:1:1621211002:0.text: Hang in there, little guy. We're almost there.
say:1:1621211002:0.source_cn: 挺住啊，小松鼠，再等我们一会。

say:0:1621212001:0.text: Let's hope this is enough to fight off the poison...
say:0:1621212001:0.source_cn: 希望这药能解小松鼠的毒……

say:1:1621213001:1.text: You made it back in time. Let's get the remedy ready.
say:1:1621213001:1.source_cn: 你们回来的不算晚，现在调配下药物吧。

say:2:1621213002:1.text: But hurry... its breathing is getting shallow.
say:2:1621213002:1.source_cn: 不过要快……这小家伙的气息越来越弱了。

document:3:421:0.text:
The main ingredients are <style="highlight">silverleaf, serenboom, and somnivine</style>. First, dry and crush the <style="highlight">silverleaf</style>. Next, gently simmer the <style="highlight">serenboom</style> petals to extract their juice. Finally, combine with chopped <style="highlight">somnivine</style> and simmer together.
This mild potion can quickly neutralize toxins in small animals.
document:3:421:0.source_cn:

say:1:1621214001:0.text: That was fast... and your ratios are nearly perfect!
say:1:1621214001:0.source_cn: 这么快就配好了……而且这比例——近乎完美。

say:2:1621214002:0.text: Even a seasoned apothecary would have trouble pulling that off in such a short time.
say:2:1621214002:0.source_cn: 就算是经验老到的药师，也未必能在这么短的时间内做到这一步。

say:3:1621214003:0.text: Lyceum clearly trains its students well—you're thorough in everything you do.
say:3:1621214003:0.source_cn: 果然，莱希拉姆的精英们，不管做什么都不含糊。

say:4:1621214004:1.text: Alright, little guy, just a drop of this... It won't taste great, but it'll help you feel better.
say:4:1621214004:1.source_cn: 好了，小家伙，来一点这个……味道不算好，但会让你轻松些。

say:5:1621214005:1.text: Hamell gently tips the remedy into the squirrel's mouth.
say:5:1621214005:1.source_cn: 哈梅尔小心地将药缓缓喂给松鼠。

say:7:1621214007:1.text: Soothing remedies don't work instantly like magic. It'll take a little time. Be patient, my mage friends.
say:7:1621214007:1.source_cn: 舒缓药可不像魔法那样立竿见影，还得等上一会儿。魔法师朋...

narration:8:1621214008:0.text: While everyone waits, Hamell begins to play his flute.
narration:8:1621214008:0.source_cn: 等待期间，哈梅尔坐在一旁吹起了笛子。

narration:9:1621214009:0.text: Light and airy at first, the tune twists into something wistful, almost like a sad memory, before lifting again at the end.
narration:9:1621214009:0.source_cn: 那曲子如风般轻快，旋律在林间盘旋，而后渐渐带上几分低落...

narration:10:1621214010:0.text: As the final note fades, Cassadee claps. Hamell smiles warmly in response.
narration:10:1621214010:0.source_cn: 曲终，科丝蒂鼓起掌来，而哈梅尔则下意识地摘帽，朝她行了...

say:11:1621214011:1.text: Mr. Hamell, it opened its eyes!

say:28:1621215029:0.text: Then I leave it to you, my mage friends. May the wind carry your steadfast steps to where they're needed most.

say:27:1621230013:1.source_cn: 我知道，他们可不是走错林子的小角色。

say:28:1621230014:1.text: I've had to tread lightly all these years—because one wrong step, and you wouldn't be looking at me in one piece. Ha!
say:28:1621230014:1.source_cn: 这些年我一直很小心——不然你们今天看到的，可能就不是个...

say:0:1621231001:0.text: I'll see you in the forest later, Magister.
say:0:1621231001:0.source_cn: 我们晚点在森林见，梅林大人。
say:0:1621231001:0.male: I'll see you in the forest later, Magister.
say:0:1621231001:0.female: I'll see you in the forest later, Magister.

say:2:1621232002:0.text: I was thinking... should we split up, or stay together for the patrol?
say:2:1621232002:0.source_cn: 我在想……我们是分头行动，还是一起巡视比较稳妥？
say:2:1621232002:0.male: I was thinking... should we split up, or stay together for the patrol?
say:2:1621232002:0.female: I was thinking... should we split up, or stay together for the patrol?

say:3:1621232003:0.text: Suddenly, a familiar flute melody drifts in from the distance.
say:3:1621232003:0.source_cn: 远处传来一阵熟悉的笛声，悠扬而诡秘。

say:4:1621232004:0.text: Wait... that's Hamell's flute, isn't it?
say:4:1621232004:0.source_cn: 等等，这个笛声……是哈梅尔先生？
say:4:1621232004:0.male: Wait... that's Hamell's flute, isn't it?
say:4:1621232004:0.female: Wait... that's Hamell's flute, isn't it?

say:5:1621232005:0.text: It's coming from the Lake of Whispers. Let's go, Magister.
say:5:1621232005:0.source_cn: 在轻语湖的方向，梅林大人，我们过去看看。
say:5:1621232005:0.male: It's coming from the Lake of Whispers. Let's go, Magister.
say:5:1621232005:0.female: It's coming from the Lake of Whispers. Let's go, Magister.

say:0:1621233001:0.text: The flute sound is coming from somewhere near the Lake of Whispers.
say:0:1621233001:0.source_cn: 笛声是在轻语湖附近传来的。
say:0:1621233001:0.male: The flute sound is coming from somewhere near the Lake of Whispers.
say:0:1621233001:0.female: The flute sound is coming from somewhere near the Lake of Whispers.

say:0:1621234001:0.text: You spot Hamell, talking with several people in poacher gear.
say:0:1621234001:0.source_cn: 你们看见哈梅尔正在与几个偷猎者装扮的人站在一起交谈。
say:0:1621234001:0.male: You spot Hamell, talking with several people in poacher gear.
say:0:1621234001:0.female: You spot Hamell, talking with several people in poacher gear.

say:1:1621234002:0.text: You can't make out much from this distance—just a few words: "hand over the animals," "boss," and "big whale".
say:1:1621234002:0.source_cn: 远处听得不真切，只依稀听到“交出动物”、“老板”、“大...

say:1:1621235001:0.text: W-what's going on? Why is Hamell talking to those poachers?
say:1:1621235001:0.source_cn: 这……这是怎么回事？哈梅尔先生怎么会和偷猎者站在一起……
say:1:1621235001:0.male: W-what's going on? Why is Hamell talking to those poachers?
say:1:1621235001:0.female: W-what's going on? Why is Hamell talking to those poachers?

say:2:1621235002:0.text: "Big whale"... they mean Little Lulu? How do they know about it? Were they after it this whole time?
say:2:1621235002:0.source_cn: 大鲸鱼……是指小蓝吗？他们怎么会知道小蓝的事？难道……...
say:2:1621235002:0.male: "Big whale"... they mean Little Lulu? How do they know about it? Were they after it this whole time?
say:2:1621235002:0.female: "Big whale"... they mean Little Lulu? How do they know about it? Were they after it this whole time?

say:3:1621235003:0.text: Little Lulu's smart. It won't come out unless I call for it.
say:3:1621235003:0.source_cn: 不过小蓝很聪明，如果不是我叫，它绝不会轻易现身的。
say:3:1621235003:0.male: Little Lulu's smart. It won't come out unless I call for it.
say:3:1621235003:0.female: Little Lulu's smart. It won't come out unless I call for it.

choice_prompt:4:1621235003.text: Little Lulu's smart. It won't come out unless I call for it.
choice_prompt:4:1621235003.source_cn: 不过小蓝很聪明，如果不是我叫，它绝不会轻易现身的。
choice_prompt:4:1621235003.male: Little Lulu's smart. It won't come out unless I call for it.
choice_prompt:4:1621235003.female: Little Lulu's smart. It won't come out unless I call for it.

say:5:1621235004:1.text: Yeah. I need to know what's really going on here.
say:5:1621235004:1.source_cn: 好，我也很想弄清楚，这到底是怎么一回事。
say:5:1621235004:1.male: Yeah. I need to know what's really going on here.
say:5:1621235004:1.female: Yeah. I want to know what's really going on here.

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 等他们把话说完再动手

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 靠近点听听他们想干什么

say:0:1621236001:0.text: We're still too far. Come on, closer.
say:0:1621236001:0.source_cn: 这里听不太清楚，我们走近些。
say:0:1621236001:0.male: We're still too far. Come on, closer.
say:0:1621236001:0.female: We're still too far. Come on, closer.

say:2:1621237001:0.text: These animals... I'll pick out a few. I'm sure your boss will be pleased.
say:2:1621237001:0.source_cn: 这些动物……我会挑几只，相信你们的老板会满意。

say:3:1621237002:0.text: Your boss? Don't play dumb, flute boy. He's OUR boss!
say:3:1621237002:0.source_cn: 你的老板？哈，别装蒜了，小混蛋，是我们的老板！

say:4:1621237003:0.text: Boys, round him up! Take them all!
say:4:1621237003:0.source_cn: 小的们，把这些动物都带走！

say:8:1621237005:0.text: Stop! What are you doing?! According to our contract, you're only supposed to take the sick ones!
say:8:1621237005:0.source_cn: 不行！你们在干什么！按契约，只能带走体弱的动物！

say:11:1621237006:0.text: Not your call anymore. Now move!

say:0:1621237101:1.text: One of the men shoves Hamell hard. He stumbles, nearly falling into the underbrush.
say:0:1621237101:1.source_cn: 流氓一把推开哈梅尔，差点将他撞进草丛。

say:2:1621237201:0.text: Those traps... those toxic fruits—that was all you, wasn't it?
say:2:1621237201:0.source_cn: 那些陷阱、毒果都是你们放的吧……？

say:3:1621237202:1.text: Well, well, look who finally put the pieces together.
say:3:1621237202:1.source_cn: 哼哼，看看咱们的大聪明，终于反应过来了？

say:4:1621237203:1.text: You and your stupid contract. "Take the sick ones", huh?
say:4:1621237203:1.source_cn: 你不是非要搞什么契约吗？什么只能带走体弱动物的蠢规矩——

say:5:1621237204:0.text: That's exactly what I did. I "helped" them along and made sure they'd fit the bill. Easy to take if they're half-dead.
say:5:1621237204:0.source_cn: 我当然得“帮”它们虚弱一点，才能顺理成章地带走。

say:7:1621237206:0.text: Ha! You've done your share of shady things, haven't you, flute man? I'll take that as a compliment.
say:7:1621237206:0.source_cn: 哈！你吹笛人做的下三滥事还少吗？我这就当你在夸我。

say:8:1621237207:0.text: If you were going to break the contract, why pretend it meant anything in the first place?
say:8:1621237207:0.source_cn: 既然你们不打算尊重契约，又何必演这出戏？

say:9:1621237208:1.text: Please. If the boss wasn't vouching for you, no one would care about your little paper promises.
say:9:1621237208:1.source_cn: 哼，要不是老板护着你，谁管你什么狗屁契约？

say:10:1621237209:0.text: But what the boss wants... is the big whale!
say:10:1621237209:0.source_cn: 但是老板要的——是大鲸鱼！

say:13:1621237210:0.text: Chief, that's not a whale, it's a river porpoise...
say:13:1621237210:0.source_cn: 头儿，那不是大鲸鱼，是江豚……

say:14:1621237211:0.text: There aren't even river porpoises in the Lyceum...
say:14:1621237211:0.source_cn: 莱希拉姆根本就没有江豚……

say:17:1621237212:0.text: What?! You think we dragged you all the way to the Lyceum just for a few sick squirrels?!
say:17:1621237212:0.source_cn: 什么！？我们千里迢迢把你送来莱希拉姆，难道就为了这几只...

say:18:1621237213:0.text: I don't know what you're talking about. I'm just helping these animals recover, like the contract said. I'm almost out of herbs, so if you want to pay up, now's the time.
say:18:1621237213:0.source_cn: 我不懂你在说什么，我只是按契约救助这些动物，药材快用完...

say:19:1621237214:0.text: Tch... If we don't find that porpoise, none of us is going back in one piece.
say:19:1621237214:0.source_cn: 哼……要是没见到江豚，我们谁都别想活着回去交差。

say:20:1621237215:0.text: I never promised you a porpoise.
say:20:1621237215:0.source_cn: 我从来没承诺过会找到江豚。

say:21:1621237216:0.text: Then maybe a swim will jog your memory. Let's see how long that attitude lasts underwater!
say:21:1621237216:0.source_cn: 好啊，那你就去水里找吧，看看在水下你还能不能嘴硬！

say:22:1621237217:0.text: Boys, toss him into the lake!

say:25:1621237218:0.text: Wait... chief, are you sure? The higher-ups really like this guy. If something happens...
say:25:1621237218:0.source_cn: 这……头儿，可是……老板对哈梅尔先生非常看重，要是出了事……

say:28:1621237219:0.text: I'll take the heat! If he won't talk, let him find the porpoise himself—at the bottom of the lake!
say:28:1621237219:0.source_cn: 我来担责！动手！既然他说不出江豚在哪，就让他下去慢慢找...

say:29:1621237220:0.text: You're insane! I told you, I haven't seen any porpoise! You can't...
say:29:1621237220:0.source_cn: 你们疯了吗……我说了，我真的没见过江豚！不能这样……

say:1:1621239001:0.text: Some party this turned out to be, huh?
say:1:1621239001:0.source_cn: 还真是场热闹的夜游会，不是吗？

say:2:1621239002:0.text: We were here to ambush poachers, Mr. Hamell. We didn't expect to run into... this.
say:2:1621239002:0.source_cn: 哈梅尔先生，我们是来埋伏偷猎者的，只是没想到……会看到这些。

say:3:1621239003:0.text: Heh... every party ends eventually. Someone always gets shown the door.
say:3:1621239003:0.source_cn: 呼……夜游会总有落幕的时候，终究会有人被请离舞台。

say:4:1621239004:1.text: I never planned to hide it forever. I once said the wind carries people where they're supposed to go. Maybe you were always meant to uncover this.
say:4:1621239004:1.source_cn: 其实我没打算一直瞒下去，我说过风总会把人吹到他该去的地...

say:5:1621239005:1.text: I'll come clean—yes, I worked for them. The animals were destined for nobles' cages. However you choose to deal with me... I won't resist.
say:5:1621239005:1.source_cn: 我承认——我确实受雇于偷猎者。那些动物，是准备卖给贵族...

choice_prompt:6:1621239005.text: I'll come clean—yes, I worked for them. The animals were destined for nobles' cages. However you choose to deal with me... I won't resist.
choice_prompt:6:1621239005.source_cn: 我承认——我确实受雇于偷猎者。那些动物，是准备卖给贵族当宠物的，你们接下来要怎么处理我……我没有异议。

say:7:1621239006:1.text: Because I never did. That was never the plan.
say:7:1621239006:1.source_cn: 因为我的确没想过伤害任何生灵。

say:8:1621239008:0.text: Mr. Hamell... why did you go this far?
say:8:1621239008:0.source_cn: 哈梅尔先生……你为什么要这样做呢？

say:9:1621239009:0.text: It all started with my own weakness...
say:9:1621239009:0.source_cn: 这一切，都是因为我的懦弱……

say:10:1621239010:0.text: I never knew my parents. I was passed around from relative to relative, never really wanted.
say:10:1621239010:0.source_cn: 从我记事起，我就没见过自己的父母，是在亲戚家流窜长大。

say:11:1621239011:1.text: The only constant in my childhood was that threat—"Cry again, and you're out!" Oddly enough, those words always made me cry harder.
say:11:1621239011:1.source_cn: 整个童年都漂泊不定，听得最多的一句话就是：“再哭就把你...

say:12:1621239012:1.text: To me, moving never felt like starting over—it just meant getting left behind again. I can't blame them, really. Who wants to keep a child who cries all the time?
say:12:1621239012:1.source_cn: 对我来说，那些搬家从来不是新的开始，而是一次次被人丢下...

say:13:1621239013:1.text: Once, I ran into the forest just to avoid another move. When my legs gave out, I dropped beneath a tree and sobbed like the world had ended.
say:13:1621239013:1.source_cn: 有一次我为了逃避搬家，跑进了森林，跑累了就跪在树下，一...

say:14:1621239014:1.text: That's when a squirrel climbed onto my knee. It didn't run. Just sat there, like it understood everything I couldn't say.
say:14:1621239014:1.source_cn: 就在那时，一只松鼠跳上了我的膝盖，静静地看着我，像是能...

say:15:1621239015:1.text: For the first time in my life, I felt seen. That little creature... it caught me when I was falling.
say:15:1621239015:1.source_cn: 那是我第一次觉得，原来连我这样的人，也能被理解，那只小...

say:16:1621239016:1.text: After that, the forest became my sanctuary. I started learning the flute just to draw the animals near, so I wouldn't be so alone anymore.
say:16:1621239016:1.source_cn: 从那以后，森林成了我的避风港，而我学笛子的原因，也只是...

say:17:1621239017:0.text: Then why did you hand those animals over to the poachers?!
say:17:1621239017:0.source_cn: 既然如此，你为何要把这些动物交给偷猎者？！

say:18:1621239018:0.text: A lot of people who do terrible things convince themselves they had no other choice. I was no different...
say:18:1621239018:0.source_cn: 很多坏人都会认为自己是无可奈何的，我也不例外……

say:19:1621239019:1.text: After a fire ravaged the woods near my hometown, Hamelin, we started an animal protection association. I joined without hesitation. For the first time, I had a purpose. I met friends who believed in the same things.
say:19:1621239019:1.source_cn: 家乡哈姆林镇因森林火灾成立了动物保护协会，我第一时间加...

say:20:1621239020:1.text: But the funding the town promised never came. We took on heavy debt just to keep things running.
say:20:1621239020:1.source_cn: 但镇上承诺的筹备款迟迟未到账，大家都背负了沉重债务，我...

say:21:1621239021:1.text: One by one, my friends gave up. The association was barely holding together.
say:21:1621239021:1.source_cn: 伙伴们陆续退出，协会面临解散。

say:22:1621239022:1.text: Then someone came to me with an offer to fund the association. The catch was that I had to track down rare creatures and hand them over to be sold as pets to the rich.
say:22:1621239022:1.source_cn: 后来，有人找到我，声称愿意资助协会……但条件，是让我帮...

say:23:1621239023:1.text: At first, I said no without a second thought. But they didn't let up. They warned me that if I didn't go along, they'd shut down the association.
say:23:1621239023:1.source_cn: 我一开始断然拒绝，可他们不断施压，甚至威胁——如果不答...

say:24:1621239024:1.text: If that happened, we wouldn't be able to help the weak and injured animals anymore. Without help, many of them wouldn't last long.
say:24:1621239024:1.source_cn: 到那时，我们就无法再继续救助那些虚弱的动物，它们可能会...

say:25:1621239025:1.text: I slowly realized we couldn't save them all. In the end, we accepted the deal because we wanted to at least save some of them.
say:25:1621239025:1.source_cn: 慢慢地，我意识到——我们根本无力保护所有动物。为了那些...

say:26:1621239026:1.text: I kept trying to convince myself that maybe being adopted by nobles wasn't the worst thing for them. At least they'd be safe from hunger and disasters.
say:26:1621239026:1.source_cn: 我也开始试着自我说服，我一遍一遍告诉自己，或许它们被贵...

say:27:1621239027:1.text: I knew this meant sacrificing some to save others. It wasn't right, but I chose what felt like the lesser evil.
say:27:1621239027:1.source_cn: 我明白，这意味着用一部分动物换取其他动物的生存，但在两...

choice_prompt:28:1621239027.text: I knew this meant sacrificing some to save others. It wasn't right, but I chose what felt like the lesser evil.
choice_prompt:28:1621239027.source_cn: 我明白，这意味着用一部分动物换取其他动物的生存，但在两害之中，我只能选择我认为更轻的那个。

say:29:1621239028:1.text: Yes, but that didn't make it okay to give in. The moment I chose to avoid the fight, I let fear become a habit. And the next time something hard came along, I ran again. And again.
say:29:1621239028:1.source_cn: 是的，但这并不是我逃避抗争的借口……因为一旦逃避一次，...

say:30:1621239029:1.text: I still regret it. That first compromise opened the door to more. I told myself the association needed money. That at least the nobles could afford medicine. I said whatever I had to, just to feel less guilty.
say:30:1621239029:1.source_cn: 我到现在还在懊悔当初选择了妥协……我为自己的逃避找了很...

say:31:1621239030:1.text: Maybe they'd get the care they needed. Maybe they'd even live more comfortably than they would in the wild.
say:31:1621239030:1.source_cn: 也许它们不仅能得到治疗，还能过上更好的生活。

choice_prompt:32:1621239030.text: Maybe they'd get the care they needed. Maybe they'd even live more comfortably than they would in the wild.
choice_prompt:32:1621239030.source_cn: 也许它们不仅能得到治疗，还能过上更好的生活。

say:33:1621239031:1.text: ... You're right. I repeated it so often I almost believed it.
say:33:1621239031:1.source_cn: ……你说得对。听起来就连我自己，都快被这个谎言说服了。
say:33:1621239031:1.male: ... You're right. I repeated it so often I almost believed it.
say:33:1621239031:1.female: ... You're right. I repeated it so often I almost believed it.

say:34:1621239032:1.text: Those poor creatures never had a say. And I built them a fantasy I wanted to believe in.
say:34:1621239032:1.source_cn: 可怜它们从未说话，我却替它们编织了一场“幸福”的幻梦。

say:35:1621239033:1.text: You're right. I've been running this whole time.
say:35:1621239033:1.source_cn: 你说得对，我只是一直在逃避。

say:36:1621239034:0.text: I get why you did it... You were trying to protect as many as you could, even when you had no good options.
say:36:1621239034:0.source_cn: 我能理解你的心情……你当时做的选择，是希望在无力的情况...

say:37:1621239035:0.text: Back at the academy, I worked on potions to treat animals. Tried to make the forest safer for them. It didn't change the world... but it helped. Even the small efforts matter.
say:37:1621239035:0.source_cn: 就像我在学院里尝试研发救护动物的魔药，或者改善森林环境...

say:38:1621239036:0.text: You don't need to fix everything. Just do what you can, as best you can. That's enough.
say:38:1621239036:0.source_cn: 即便无法掌控所有事情，只要尽力去做，就已经是最重要的。

say:39:1621239037:0.text: You're right... Maybe redemption isn't about fixing everything. It's about doing what we can, without breaking ourselves along the way.
say:39:1621239037:0.source_cn: 你说得对……或许救赎本就该量力而行，而不是用梦想去拖垮彼此。

say:40:1621239038:1.text: Trying to keep the association going was a lost cause from the start. I should've realized it sooner, but I couldn't make myself stop.
say:40:1621239038:1.source_cn: 维系协会的愿景，从一开始就像一首我演奏不完的曲子，我早...

say:41:1621239039:1.text: But now things have gone too far... Someone has to take responsibility. If you won't turn me in, I'll do it myself.
say:41:1621239039:1.source_cn: 如今事已至此……必须有人承担后果，如果你们不打算立刻处...

say:42:1621239040:1.text: Just as Hamell finishes speaking, a faint light shimmers in the direction of the Lake of Whispers, slowly growing brighter.
say:42:1621239040:1.source_cn: 哈梅尔的话音未落，轻语湖方向传来一丝微弱的光芒，渐渐明...

say:44:1621239042:0.text: Heh... my friend, have you come to say goodbye?
say:44:1621239042:0.source_cn: 呵呵……朋友，你也来为我道别了吗？

choice:32:1:2.text: Are you still going to keep running?
choice:32:1:2.male: Are you still going to keep running?
choice:32:1:2.female: Are you still going to keep running?

choice:28:1:2.text: The association is your home, isn't it?
choice:28:1:2.source_cn: 协会对你而言是个归处
choice:28:1:2.male: The association is your home, isn't it?
choice:28:1:2.female: The association is your home, isn't it?

choice:6:0:1.text: Doesn't sound like you meant them harm.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 你刚才的话不像是伤害动物的人
choice:6:0:1.male: Doesn't sound like you meant them harm.
choice:6:0:1.female: Doesn't sound like you meant them harm.

say:46:1621239007:1.text: I know I'll have to atone eventually. I've owed this forest more than I can repay...
say:46:1621239007:1.source_cn: 迟早都要偿还，我欠这片森林太多了……

choice:6:1:2.text: You will be dealt with, but not now.
choice:6:1:2.male: You will be dealt with, but not now.
choice:6:1:2.female: You will be dealt with, but not now.

say:0:1621240001:0.text: Don't worry. That glow... it's just a friend, here to see me off.
say:0:1621240001:0.source_cn: 别担心，那光芒是这位朋友来为我送别的。

say:1:1621240002:0.text: If you don't mind, would you walk me there?
say:1:1621240002:0.source_cn: 如果可以的话，请陪我一起过去吧。

say:1:1621241001:1.text: Little Lulu rarely approaches strangers on its own... could it be...
say:1:1621241001:1.source_cn: 我很少见到小蓝会主动接近陌生人……难道……

say:2:1621241002:1.text: You're reading too much into it. We met by chance, not because of any trick from the association.
say:2:1621241002:1.source_cn: 你多心了，我遇到它纯属偶然，并不是协会的引导技艺。

say:3:1621241003:1.text: I've read about the azure river porpoise. It's no ordinary animal. It's smart, sensitive, and able to sense both emotions and magic.
say:3:1621241003:1.source_cn: 我在文献中读到过，神话蓝鳍豚不是普通的动物，非常聪明，...

say:4:1621241004:1.text: No one with ill intent can get near it. That's why the poachers never stood a chance.
say:4:1621241004:1.source_cn: 那些怀着恶意的人根本靠近不了它，这也是偷猎者们至今都抓...

say:5:1621241005:1.text: So you knew about Little Lulu all along?
say:5:1621241005:1.source_cn: 所以你一开始就知道小蓝的存在？

say:6:1621241006:1.source_cn: 是的，从一开始我就知道……

say:7:1621241007:1.text: I'll never forget the moment I first saw it. It was like catching a glimpse of something impossibly gentle, like spring wind brushing your cheek, or petals blooming on water.
say:7:1621241007:1.source_cn: 我觉得我的余生都无法忘记遇见它的瞬间了，我仿佛看见了一...

say:8:1621241008:1.text: And in that moment, I realized—some things in this world are worth giving everything to protect.
say:8:1621241008:1.source_cn: 那一刻，我知道，这个世界上，有些东西值得用生命去守护。

say:9:1621241009:1.source_cn: 是的，哈梅尔先生，你说的很对。

say:10:1621241010:1.text: That bond you speak of... it makes me feel like maybe protection goes both ways.
say:10:1621241010:1.source_cn: 这种生命之间的链接感，甚至让我认为守护是相互的……

say:11:1621241011:0.text: In a way, Little Lulu's been protecting me too. Protecting... all of us.
say:11:1621241011:0.source_cn: 某种意义上，小蓝也在守护着我，守护着……我们。

say:12:1621241012:0.text: That's a beautiful way to put it... Deep down, I've always believed the same.
say:12:1621241012:0.source_cn: 相互守护……这真是动人的说法，我也常在心底这样相信。

say:13:1621241013:0.text: That's why I need to let go of the past and earn my place in this forest again.
say:13:1621241013:0.source_cn: 正因如此，我才更该洗净过往的尘埃，让自己有资格再踏入这...

say:14:1621241014:0.text: And when that day comes, I'll return with my flute, and do what I can to protect them.
say:14:1621241014:0.source_cn: 等到那一天，我会带着笛声归来，用自己力所能及的方式守护...

say:1:1621244001:0.text: Mr. Hamell turned himself in, and the forest is quiet again, just like before.
say:1:1621244001:0.source_cn: 哈梅尔先生已经自首了，森林也逐渐恢复了往日的宁静。
say:1:1621244001:0.male: Mr. Hamell turned himself in, and the forest is quiet again, just like before.
say:1:1621244001:0.female: Mr. Hamell turned himself in, and the forest is quiet again, just like before.

say:2:1621244002:1.text: The little creatures he left in our care are healing nicely. They're all going to be fine.
say:2:1621244002:1.source_cn: 他“托付”给我们的那些小家伙们恢复得不错，都没什么大碍。
say:2:1621244002:1.male: The little creatures he left in our care are healing nicely. They're all going to be fine.
say:2:1621244002:1.female: The little creatures he left in our care are healing nicely. They're all going to be fine.
